title: What premarital screening covers
summary: Premarital screening in the UAE is a set of blood tests before marriage. It checks for some inherited blood conditions, such as thalassaemia and sickle cell, and some infections.
body: The genetic part shows whether each partner carries a changed copy of certain genes. In Abu Dhabi, genetic testing for Emirati couples now covers many more conditions; your screening centre can tell you exactly which tests you had. No screening tests for every possible genetic condition. The result is information for the couple: screening does not decide whether a couple can marry. Couples who are both carriers of the same condition are offered genetic counselling.

sources.title: DoH integrates genetic testing as an integral component of the premarital screening programme
